research.title: Parallel GPU Implementation for Coral Fractal Generation
research.event: Escola Regional de Alto Desempenho da Região Sul (ERAD-RS)
research.abs: This paper describes a parallel GPU implementation for generating coral fractals using the Diffusion-Limited Aggregation (DLA) algorithm. The implementation was developed in C++ and parallelized using the CUDA platform. A speedup of up to 40x was achieved; however, the speedup was observed to plateau due to the maximum number of threads that can be active simultaneously on the GPU.

research.title: Performance Gain Evaluation Using Parallelism on IoT Data from Smart Cities
research.event: Escola Regional de Alto Desempenho da Região Sul (ERAD-RS)
research.abs: This paper evaluates the use of different parallelism techniques for processing IoT data in smart cities. To this end, OpenMP, MPI, Multiprocessing, and Dask were used to identify sensor failures and assess performance gains, achieving a speedup of up to 5.16 with Dask. The results reinforce the advantages of using parallelism for processing large volumes of data.
